svg.aria-label: Two views of the camera's angles. Seen from above, with +Y towards you, yaw 0 looks down -Z and yaw grows turning left, reaching -X at yaw +90 degrees. Seen from the side, pitch is the angle of forward above the yaw direction: forward climbs sin(pitch) and keeps cos(pitch) along the ground.
